Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The agent concluded there were five studio albums by relying on a Genius.com search snippet instead of verifying against the required source (the 2022 English Wikipedia). This led to misclassifying “Cantora 1” and “Cantora 2” as separate studio albums and inflating the count. According to Wikipedia, the studio albums in 2000–2009 are Argentina quiere cantar (2003), Corazón libre (2005), and Cantora (2009), totaling three.
